patch_description: This version concentrates two-hop support on the highest-demand OD pairs: it uses the 90th-percentile cutoff and selects at most three promising relay nodes per pair. Relay quality accounts for incident traffic and the demand on the two legs, while direct-link rewards remain available for every link. The sparse couplings should limit unnecessary interactions and encourage a smaller set of useful relay structures. The degree penalty is kept moderate so it can help feasibility without overwhelming the traffic-based terms.
